product_metadata.title: Spectrum Diversified Duo Bar & Paper Holder No Installation 2-in-1 Cabinet Paper Towel Dispenser & Towel Bar, Under Sink Storage & Organization, Standard, Chrome
features: INTRODUCE MODERN STYLE: With clean, smooth lines, this organizer inspires an up-to-date look that is fresh and contemporary. The modern finishes complement a variety of kitchen styles and color schemes, showing off your style in the best light.

SIMPLE REFILLING: To replace your kitchen towels or paper towels, simply slide the dirty hand towel off the center rod and slide the replacement washcloth in place. No knobs or arms to adjust. Paper towel holder fits both standard and jumbo rolls.

AVOID INSTALLATION: Add extra storage without all the hardware. Padded brackets slide easily over cabinet doors for quick, no fuss installation. No tools required. Perfect for apartments, rental homes, or RVs.

DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: The sturdy steel construction withstands kitchen wear and tear and heavy use. The durable metal brackets and towel rack do not bend for stable support of kitchen dish towels and hand towels in the bathroom.

DIMENSIONS: 12" L X 4.5" W X 6.5" H; to clean, wipe with a damp cloth and towel dry. Cabinet shelves may obstruct cabinet door from properly closing when item is used. Please measure in advance of purchase.
description: The Duo Over the Cabinet Towel Bar & Paper Towel Holder from Spectrum Diversified instantly transforms unused space on both sides of cabinet doors into useful organization solutions. This two-in-one unit allows hand or dish towels to hang from the towel bar while the opposite side holds a standard or jumbo paper towel roll. To replace your kitchen towels or paper towels, simply slide the dirty hand towel off the center rod and slide the replacement washcloth in place. No knobs or arms to adjust. Paper towel holder fits both standard and jumbo rolls. Padded foam brackets easily slide over standard cabinet doors without any tools or installation. With clean, smooth lines, this organizer inspires an up-to-date look that is fresh and contemporary. The modern finishes complement a variety of kitchen styles and color schemes, showing off your style in the best light. Organizing your kitchen, bath or laundry room cabinets has never been this easy! The sturdy steel construction withstands kitchen wear and tear and heavy use. The durable metal brackets and towel rack do not bend for stable support of kitchen dish towels and hand towels in the bathroom. Add extra storage without all the hardware. Padded brackets slide easily over cabinet doors for quick, no fuss installation. No tools required. Perfect for apartments, rental homes, or RVs. Cabinet shelves may obstruct cabinet door from properly closing when item is used. Please measure in advance of purchase. Made of sturdy steel.
